DOWN-THE-FURROW — ground-level straight down a furrow between dense violet lavender rows, ordered lines of abundant purple blooms racing to the empty horizon.
ABOVE-THE-TOPS — low-angle just above a sea of cobalt blue delphinium heads, ranks of lush bloom-mass receding in crisp colored layers to the far field edge.
HILLTOP OVERLOOK — from a gentle rise, the whole patterned field of rose-pink tulip blocks spreads below, geometry laid out in vivid bands to the empty horizon.
LOW AERIAL — drone view low over the field, planting blocks of indigo and cream blooms read cleanly as bold geometric bands of dense color from above.
OBLIQUE + BIG SKY — three-quarter oblique catching rows of overflowing lilac blooms and a vast clear warm-toned sky, the field pattern crisp across the empty horizon.
